# Cross-Repo & CI Ordering Checklist: Comprehensive live QuickFIX interop conversation

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the clauses spanning the two repositories — digest pinning, republish ordering, consumer blast radius, and the capability handshake (FR-016a/b/c, FR-026, R-11).
**Created**: 2026-09-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [research.md](../research.md) §R-11 · [plan.md](../plan.md) §External obligations

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

> ⚠️ **This domain produced two defects that survived ten Gate A rounds**, both of the same shape: an
> obligation stated in one artifact and unreachable from the artifact a reader would consult. R-11
> decided *"pin `interop-smoke.yml` **and the existing cells**"*; the obligations table recorded only the
> first half, and the file carrying the second half had no row at all. These items test for more of it.

## Obligation Reachability

- [ ] CHK001 Does every file **outside** the bundle that this feature must change have a row in `plan.md` § *External obligations*, per RC-B's unconditional rule? [Completeness, Plan §RC-B]
- [ ] CHK002 Is each obligations row **as wide as** the decision it implements — specifically, does the pinning row cover every consumer R-11 names rather than the one it happens to mention? [Consistency, Research §R-11]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the requirements about `:latest` blast radius reachable from the workflow files themselves, or only from a research item a reader would not open? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the rule that the *Required by* column carries **identifiers and separators only** stated where an editor of the table will see it, with the consequence (a normative clause landing there obligates nothing)? [Clarity, Plan §External obligations]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements traceable from a decision in `research.md` through to an obligation row without the wording narrowing at each hop? [Traceability]

## Digest Pinning & Republish Ordering

- [ ] CHK006 Is the ordering requirement — pin existing consumers **before** republishing — stated as a precondition rather than as a step that can be reordered? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK007 Are **all** consumers of the counterparty image enumerated in the requirements, with the enumeration method given so a new consumer is caught? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Do the requirements account for consumers triggered on `pull_request` across all branches, where a pin merged to the default branch **does not reach open PRs**? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the tension between pinning the matrix to the pre-089 digest and 089's own cells needing the **new** image stated and resolved, rather than left for an implementer to discover? [Conflict, Spec §FR-016b]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements defined for reading the published digest from the run's **step log** rather than the job conclusion? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the requirement that the image be referenced by **immutable digest, not a mutable tag** stated with the failure it prevents? [Traceability, Spec §FR-016b]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the two acceptable orderings (pin-first vs publish-under-a-new-tag) both specified, with the trade-off stated, so a reader knows which was chosen and why? [Completeness, Research §R-11]

## Failure Direction of the Consumers

- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for the case where the image cannot be pulled — specifically that the consumer **skips with a reason and stays GREEN** — so that "089 is passing" is not read as "the cell ran"? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the rule that an **unpullable pin is a skip, and a skip is green** stated at every site that pins a digest? [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements specified for evidencing that a cell **actually ran**, as distinct from the job reporting success? [Measurability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Is a counterparty-unavailable outcome required to remain distinguishable from a pass in **both** the cell result and the evidence record? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]

## Capability Handshake

- [ ] CHK017 Is the capability-minimums artifact identified as the single normative home of every required-version operand, with all pointing sites deferring to it rather than restating values? [Consistency, Plan §External obligations]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a cell whose minimum is **not declared** — specifically that it FAILS rather than passing or skipping? [Edge Case, Contract §C-2]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the pre-conversation hello gate specified to run **before** the gtest is launched, with the consequence of running it later stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016a]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for an absent hello as a **failure** rather than a stale-peer skip, and is the distinction between "is it the right peer" and "is there a peer" drawn? [Ambiguity, Data-model §1]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the requirement that `script_digest` be **recomputed** by each side over the file it actually opened — never copied from the environment — stated with the reason? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008c]

## Two-Repository Boundary

- [ ] CHK022 Is the split between parent-side counterparty *programs* and submodule-side *assertions* stated as a constraint with its reason (QuickFIX is deliberately outside fixpp's dependency graph)? [Clarity, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for how parent-side C++/Java changes receive a review disposition, given that Gate A/B operate on the library PR? [Gap, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the consequence of a library PR merging **ahead** of the image specified as a broken tree, rather than left implicit in the ordering? [Coverage, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [ ] CHK025 Are the requirements about what the publish **does not** cover — that the arm's verdict lands post-merge and gates no pull request — stated where a reader would otherwise infer PR-time coverage? [Clarity, Plan §Structure Decision]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK026 Does any requirement in this domain state a pinned digest, tag or version as a **value** where the value will move, without a re-derivation recipe? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Are `FR-020`'s regression obligation and the republish safety argument distinguished — i.e. is it clear that reasoning about an opt-in gate is not the measurement FR-020 requires? [Conflict, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK028 Do the requirements name which repository each obligation lands in, at every row, so a reader never has to infer it from a path prefix? [Clarity]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
